senses.definition: n.[m.] restraint, coercion;—ע׳ abs.: מֵע׳ וּמִמִּשְׁפָּט Is 53:8 from (as a result of) coercion and judgment he was taken off; cstr. ע׳ רָעָה ψ 107:39; ע׳ רָ֑חַם Pr 30:16 restraint of womb, barrenness (so ψ 107:39 PerlesAnal. 85).
